misprints.note: The first vowel is clearly alpha in the print.

uncertain.note: The print shows 's ,' with a gap where an abbreviation period is expected. It could be a dropped or broken period, so it is kept as 's,'.
The genitive ending appears to have no accent or breathing in the print, so it is written 'ακος'.
The ending 'έντος' appears with an acute only and no breathing.
